findings: The finite phase table covers original drain, held/parked state, complete witness adoption, private restore acceptance, source installation, reservoir startup, provider pin/startup and guard release.
Observed-effect reconciliation is a new append-only receipt with full current predicates; it neither fabricates a historical command return nor repeats the original action.

Unknown outcomes without sufficient positive effect evidence remain blocked. Original log/QoS anchors, signal wall times, rollback bytes, state and failures remain preserved. Provider-admitted history is never rolled back.
Complete existing witnesses and clean private-restore success can be adopted without rerunning exclusive producers or launching another child. Partial/unresolved outputs stay blocked and retained.
implementation_requirements: Fresh controller and resume_one must use the same per-transaction exclusion and durable executor identity; locking only resume does not exclude a live original caller.

Each one-step claim must bind controller and Host heads, immutable preparation/plan, boot/owner and exact evidence. Recheck under the lock before any Host action; interrupted claims never imply no external effect.
Extend inspector and journal grammar for reconciliation/claims/results together. Preserve monotonically increasing Host operations and original records; no fabricated mutation_completed event.
Retained attach must reconstruct full startup records and original coverage anchors without recapturing or weakening applied-versus-rollback validation.

Adoption requires every stated phase predicate, including old absence, exact ownership, stopped barrier where required, startup/semantic witnesses and no unresolved child. Hash or argv equality alone is insufficient.

Keep both execution flags disabled and no operational execute CLI until the integrated source, fake failures, actual owned interruption/continuation fixture and separate numerical prerequisites are accepted.
